scientific_integrity: The known modal spinodal is explicitly credited to the source; the general triangular norm-contractivity threshold is explicitly acknowledged as prior coverage for the half-filling special case. The new active-model phase portrait and sharp all-mode high-activity gain are separately demonstrated.
scientific_limitations: Only the deterministic PDE linearized about a spatially uniform state on a finite one-dimensional torus, in unweighted Euclidean species-density norm; no nonlinear, finite-particle, or stochastic-response theorem. Unindexed prior transient-response literature remains a possible originality risk.
title: Sharp nonmodal amplification in an interacting active lattice gas
